items.source: Simple interface that represents a fully configured RSocket server. Allows the server to be started and stopped.
items.translation: 表示完全配置的 RSocket 服务器的简单接口。允许启动和停止服务器，分别对应started和stopped。

items.source: Return the address this server is listening on.
items.translation: 返回该服务器监听的地址。

items.source: RSocketServerException - if the server cannot be started
items.translation: RSocketServerException - 如果无法启动服务器

items.source: RSocketServerException - if the server cannot be stopped
items.translation: RSocketServerException - 如果无法停止服务器

items.source: Choice of transport protocol for the RSocket server.
items.translation: RSocket 服务器的传输协议选择。

items.source:
Starts the RSocket server. Calling this method on an already started server has no
effect.
items.translation: 启动 RSocket 服务器。在已启动的服务器上调用此方法无效。

items.source:
Stops the RSocket server. Calling this method on an already stopped server has no
effect.
items.translation: 停止 RSocket 服务器。对已停止的服务器调用此方法无效。
